scope: Rigid shadow geometry of the concrete drum mixer and cordless mixer only; visible meshes, movable drum/paddle, editor picking and collisions remain separate.
environment: Windows desktop Chrome in 390x844 DPR3 touch emulation, WebGL backend, renderer pixel ratio 1.75; physical iPhone/Safari not tested. Host CPU Intel Core Ultra 9 285K; available GPUs Intel Graphics and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 (browser adapter not independently confirmed).

samePageAB.scene: Camera fixed at the mixing station, 180 animation frames per phase, alternating original and batched shadow casters on one loaded page

visualReview: Same 780x1688 mixing-station pose inspected before/after. Mean absolute RGB difference 0.318/255; 0.107% of pixels differed by more than 20 in any channel, predominantly changing hand/model animation. No lost shadows or visible material change observed.
memoryCost: Two new position buffers total 829656 bytes, plus GPU copies and object overhead.
checks: editor direct selection of both mixer roots
limits: Draw-call reduction is proven; host frame timings overlap and do not prove smooth physical-phone playback. A separate mixing-world-tool-switch test fails at its cement-stroke assertion on both public baseline and candidate, so this change does not claim that workflow passes.
